posts.title: Launch HN: Onlook (YC W25) – An open-source developer tool for designers
posts.description: Hey HN, I'm Daniel, founder of Onlook ( https://github.com/onlook-dev/onlook and onlook.com). Onlook is a desktop app that puts a canvas on top of your real codebase, letting you design directly in code with the agent you already use. posts.title: Launch HN: StarSling (YC P25) – Self-improving CI for agent-volume repos
posts.description: We’re Yonas and Daniel and we’re building StarSling ( https://starsling.dev ), fast GitHub Actions runners with AI agents that ship PRs to continuously improve your tests and workflows. Every CI job gets its own ephemeral sandbox on the fastest Zen 5 machines and NVMe Disk with unlimited concurrency so a burst of agent PRs all run at once.
